query:
-- Get all leads with summer camp interest from FB ads
SELECT l.id, l.parentName, l.email, l.phone, l.kidName, l.programInterest, l.pipelineStage, l.utmSource, l.utmCampaign
FROM leads l
WHERE (l.programInterest LIKE '%Summer Camp%' OR l.programInterest LIKE '%summer_camp%' OR l.utmCampaign LIKE '%summer_camp%')
  AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email != ''
ORDER BY l.createdAt DESC;

-- Also get all current camp registrations to cross-reference
SELECT DISTINCT email, parentName FROM campRegistrations WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND email != '';
